definitions.name: U2B.REV
definitions.body: [ 'UO' BIND UO 'price' GET 'UP' BIND UO 'qty' GET UP MUL 0 UP NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> total of qty times price over the orders that have a price

definitions.name: U2B.QTYBY
definitions.body: 'UO' BIND UO [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UO [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'UG' BIND UG KEYS UG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> Record from sku to summed qty, skus in order of first appearance

definitions.name: U2B.MISSING
definitions.note: Vector of readings -> Vector of 1 (missing, NIL) or 0 (present)

definitions.name: U2B.BRED
definitions.note: String of brackets -> the String with each adjacent () and [] pair deleted once

definitions.name: U2B.BREDUCE
definitions.body: U2B.BRED U2B.BRED U2B.BRED U2B.BRED U2B.BRED U2B.BRED
definitions.note: String of up to 12 brackets -> what remains after deleting matched adjacent pairs until none is left
